from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess
q=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def digest(p):
 with p.open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
result=subprocess.run(['python3',str(q/'guard.py')],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(q/'packaging-source-guard.log').write_bytes(result.stdout)
assert result.returncode==0
proof=json.loads((q/'runtime-proof.json').read_text())
assert proof['verdict']=='PASS' and proof['whole_source_files']==4730
assert proof['events_sha256']==digest(q/'events.jsonl') and proof['raw_attached_PTY_sha256']==digest(q/'launcher-pty.log')
assert len(proof['captures'])==17
for item in proof['captures']:
 p=q/item['path']; assert p.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and digest(p)==item['sha256']
assert proof['new_original_reference_credit']==0 and proof['no_parallel_scheduler_or_execution_credit']
for filename in ['native-model-proof.json','current-parallel-capability-proof.json','final-closure-and-guard.json','report-format-proof.json']:
 assert json.loads((q/filename).read_text())['verdict']=='PASS'
critical=['runtime-proof.json','native-model-proof.json','current-parallel-capability-proof.json','final-closure-and-guard.json','review-report.md','events.jsonl','launcher-pty.log','current-decoder-build-proof.json','current-app-binding.json','cleanup-receipt.json','lease-released.json']
receipt={'verdict':'PASS','source_commit':proof['source_commit'],'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'all4730_source_hashes_fixed7_index_worktree_untracked_unchanged_after_packaging':True,'proof_and_capture_hash_citations_verified':True,'critical_evidence':[{'path':n,'bytes':(q/n).stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(q/n)} for n in critical],'runtime_released_no_compiler_JVM_Gradle_native_execution':True,'manifest_self_excluded':True}
(q/'packaging-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
files=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(q)),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p)} for p in sorted(q.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p!=q/'artifact-manifest.json']
manifest={'source_commit':proof['source_commit'],'files':files,'file_count':len(files),'total_bytes':sum(x['bytes'] for x in files),'includes_all_raw_evidence_generated_private_fixture_profile_and_recipes':True,'self_excluded':True}
(q/'artifact-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
assert {str(p.relative_to(q)) for p in q.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p!=q/'artifact-manifest.json'}=={item['path'] for item in files}
for item in files:
 p=q/item['path'];assert p.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and digest(p)==item['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'verdict':'PASS','files':len(files),'total_bytes':manifest['total_bytes'],'manifest_sha256':digest(q/'artifact-manifest.json'),'critical_hashes':{n:digest(q/n) for n in critical}}))
